snippet.title: Our Bad Ending horror game trailer
snippet.description:
A ritual. A festering, unrequited love.

Sink into a humid and visceral Southeast Asian horror about the pursuit of a doomed lesbian love. Is a bad ending better than no ending at all?

💔Download the visual novel for PC & Mac at https://feverfiction.itch.io/our-bad-ending
Developed by FEVER FICTION: http://feverfiction.com/
Music by Aleksis Tristan Shaw and Makoto Hiramatsu

---

Nothing just me making my game trailer 5 months late but yes enjoy lesbians and horror also the singaporean setting and references.....for the few of you out there.
